posts.title: Understanding Shebangs
posts.description: At the very top of a shell script, there is often a seemingly insignificant line that determines how the entire script is executed: the shebang. It begins with #!, but the words and paths that follow can make a meaningful difference to portability, compatibility and reliability. posts.title: When Maintaining Opensource Software Becomes Too Much
posts.description: The Gentoo Linux community is facing a small but revealing reminder of one of the biggest challenges in open-source software: keeping a project alive is not always as simple as making the source code available.
